Calculate Total RF-EMF Dose from All Sources

total_dose.Rd

Calculates the total RF-EMF dose from all available RF-EMF sources for a specific tissue.

Usage

total_dose(sample, tissue, params = load_params())

Arguments

sample

A list with input values for a single observation. List elements must match the names and data types of the provided example dataset and must not be NA.

tissue

Tissue for which to calculate dose (default: "brain" or "body")

params

Parameter list (optional). If not specified, calculations use default parameters.

Value

Named vector of the RF-EMF doses of the 8 exposure sources (call_dose, data_dose, dect_dose, farf_dose, wifi_dose, lptp_dose, tblt_dose, other_dose) in mJ/kg/day for the specified tissue.

Details

A detailed description of the dose calculation will follow.
